user.title: Set up BatteryBrain
user.description: BatteryBrain automatically discovers all battery entities and monitors their health.

data_description.developer_mode: Enables a test mode switch that accelerates time by 200x for testing purposes.

data_description.scan_battery_level_attr: Also monitor entities that expose a battery_level attribute, even without the battery device class.
data_description.binary_low_is_critical: Mark binary battery sensors as critical instead of warning when they report low.
data_description.exclude_entities: Select entities to exclude from battery monitoring.
